pages.scene: A magical jungle entrance with tall trees, soft mist, golden morning light filtering through leaves.

prompt.final_text:
Soft Pixar-style children's storybook illustration. 1024x1024 resolution.

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Soft pastel color palette (lush greens, warm yellows, soft blues)
- Warm cinematic lighting with gentle glow
- Shallow depth of field with soft background blur
- Smooth gradients, no harsh edges
- Emotionally warm, magical storytelling tone
- Consistent rendering style across all pages

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:
- Eye-level camera
- Medium shot framing
- Subject positioned center-left (~45% horizontal)
- Right side intentionally left soft/blurred for text placement
- No clutter on right side
- Depth layering: foreground, midground, background

LIGHTING:
- Primary light source: top-left soft warm light
- Ambient jungle glow filling shadows
- No harsh shadows anywhere
- Face region must be evenly lit with zero shadow

MAIN CHARACTER:
- Young child (age 4–6)
- Short natural dark hair
- Wearing light yellow t-shirt and beige shorts
- Brown hat with black lace (MANDATORY)
- Soft rounded Pixar-style proportions

CRITICAL FACE OVERLAY REQUIREMENTS:
- Face MUST be a clean, smooth, featureless oval
- NO eyes, NO nose, NO mouth, NO eyebrows
- Skin tone uniform: #E8C4A0
- No gradients, no highlights, no shadows on face
- Face bounding box fixed at (512,300), size approx 170x190 pixels
- Face must be fully unobstructed (no hair, no objects crossing)
- Head orientation: slight left yaw (~5 degrees), slight downward pitch (~3 degrees)
- No motion blur, no tilt variation beyond 10%

Aspect Ratio - 9:16

SCENE DESCRIPTION:
A magical jungle entrance with tall trees, soft mist, golden morning light filtering through leaves.

CONSTRAINTS:
- No perspective distortion
- No extreme angles
- Maintain consistency with previous pages

OUTPUT QUALITY:
- High detail
- Clean rendering
- Child-friendly aesthetic
